result:
I added a "Suspensa?" filter to the advanced search on the scholarship allocation screen. I haven't run the app or any tests, and I only syntax-checked the controller.

The filter has three options: "Todas", "Suspensas" and "Não suspensas". An allocation counts as suspended when it has a suspension that is marked active and whose start and end dates include today.

The changes are in three places:
- **`app/controllers/scholarship_durations_controller.rb`:** the new `suspended` search column and its search condition.
- **`app/helpers/scholarship_durations_helper.rb`:** the dropdown for the new filter.
- **`config/locales/scholarship_duration.pt-BR.yml`:** the "Suspensa?" label.

I wrote the dropdown option labels directly in Portuguese in the helper. The existing "Ativas/Inativas" filter does the same, so I followed that pattern rather than adding locale keys.
